description: This file defines the Aws\MockHandler class, which manages a queue of mock responses or exceptions for testing AWS SDK interactions. It implements promise-based handling of responses, allowing simulation of AWS service responses in tests.

classes.name: MockHandler
classes.description: A mock handler for AWS SDK that returns predefined responses or exceptions, supporting promise-based asynchronous handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the mock handler with an optional queue of results/exceptions and callbacks for fulfilled/rejected promises.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Adds one or more ResultInterface or Exception objects to the queue.

methods.name: appendException
methods.description: Adds one or more Exception or Throwable objects to the queue.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles a command and request, returning a promise that resolves or rejects based on the queued responses.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the number of remaining items in the queue.
